decision.reasoning_trace: After reviewing the catalog, I excluded several miscategorized items such as camping stoves, cookware, and clothing to focus on actual backpacks. My consideration set included a mix of tactical rucksacks, a discreet EDC bag, and a compact sling. I compared the QT&QY 45L (prod_backpacks_057) with the Seibertron Falcon (prod_backpacks_107) and the Warriors Product (prod_backpacks_064). While the Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_038) is a high-quality premium option, I selected the QT&QY 45L as the final choice because it offers the best value-to-capacity ratio, backed by over 6,000 reviews and a strong 4.7-star rating, making it the most reliable versatile choice for both hiking and daily use.
